body:
Dear friend,

Greetings from the mountain! The snow is melting up here at last, and the lambs are coming, one after another.

I could use a steady pair of hands. Will you climb up and help? Take the map; the trail is clear now.
summary: Help Mr. Silas settle the ewes and their new lambs.
done: Every lamb is snug with its mother!

tasks.where: at the coop by your house
from the jug in your kitchen
